about: Jonathan R. Levine is an attorney providing legal services covering Family Law.

Jonathan Levine, who practices law in Atlanta, Georgia, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Georgia School of Law. He graduated in 1985. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1985.
